op5e.settings.berriesWeightless.name: Weightless Berries
op5e.settings.berriesWeightless.hint: When enabled, Berries do not count toward encumbrance (even if the GM has currency weight enabled).
op5e.settings.animationsAutorec.name: Add OP5e animations to Automated Animations
op5e.settings.animationsAutorec.hint: GM only. Needs Automated Animations and dnd5e-animations. Adds OP5e item names to Automated Animations' autorecognition menus once per OP5e version; never overwrites existing entries.
op5e.diamondSoul.dialogContent: This save failed. Spend 1 spirit point to reroll? ({remaining} spirit remaining)
op5e.combatMedicine.redirectNotice: Field Surgeon: using Combat Medicine instead of base Experimental Medicine.
op5e.relentlessRage.dialogContent: You dropped to 0 HP while raging. Make a DC {dc} Constitution save to drop to 1 HP instead?
op5e.relentlessRage.success: Relentless Rage succeeds — you are at 1 HP. Next save DC: {dc}.
op5e.relentlessRage.failure: Relentless Rage failed — you remain at 0 HP.
op5e.hakiAdvancement.invalidChoice: That Haki feat is not available for your current branches. Upgrade a branch you started, or begin a new branch at Novice.
op5e.flameInvesture.dialogContent: Cast a flame creation granted by this trait.
op5e.flameInvesture.noSpells: No Flame Investure creations found on this actor.
op5e.flameInvesture.noFireballUses: No Fireball uses remaining until a long rest.
op5e.flameInvesture.missingSpell: That creation is not on your character sheet.
op5e.bubbleFloater.applied: Bubble Floater active (8 hours, +20 ft walk).
op5e.giantsEndurance.noRecentDamage: Use Giant's Endurance after you take damage (reaction).
SHOPTRADE.CurrencyModeHint: Coins: all dnd5e coins with change making. Single: one coin type only. A world whose config has one currency (like Berries) is always single.
SHOPTRADE.SellRatio: Shop sell ratio (percent of the price a shop pays)
op5e.settings.bigHitFx.name: Big-hit effects
op5e.settings.bigHitFx.hint: A damage roll at or above the threshold below (or a critical hit) shakes every player's screen and plays an explosion on the target (needs Sequencer and JB2A for the explosion).
op5e.settings.bigHitThreshold.name: Big-hit damage threshold
op5e.settings.bigHitThreshold.hint: Total damage of one roll that counts as a big hit.
op5e.settings.bigHitShake.name: Screen shake on big hits
op5e.settings.bigHitShake.hint: Turn this off if the screen shake bothers you. It only affects your own screen.
op5e.settings.extraSources.name: Extra compendium sources
op5e.settings.extraSources.label: Choose sources
op5e.settings.extraSources.hint: Item compendiums (for example a D&D Beyond import) that players may also pick from in Create OPC, next to the op5e content. Only referenced, never copied.
